name: tl
summary: Yamaha total-level gain: audio × cv × a 0..99 `level` mapped to a Q15 gain via `fm1_level_gain` (0.25 dB/step: 99 = max, 50 ≈ −12 dB, 0 = silence), shifted `>> 2` for the −12 dB single-operator headroom (four additive carriers then sum to 0 dBFS). Bipolar `k` (key-follow) and `vk` (velocity-follow) factors (Q15) push the level toward 0/99 (block-derived `level_eff`).
